title: InsideEVs: The Cadillac Escalade IQ crushed its estimated range in a 70-mph test (Moloughney, 2025-06-23)
notes: 2025 Escalade IQ held a GPS-measured 70 mph on the NJ Turnpike: 482.2 mi on one charge, 222.7 kWh used in total (214.9 kWh driving + 7.8 kWh climate and charge prep), cabin 70 F low fan, ambient rising into the 80s F. Trim and wheels not stated.
